model.evidence: The current task-creation API accepts an explicit model field and enumerates GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-6 Astra, but task list/read results expose no independent effective-model readback.

effort.evidence: The current task-creation API accepts an explicit thinking field with supported per-model effort values, but task list/read results expose no independent effective-effort readback.

fast_mode.evidence: The current task-creation API exposes neither a Fast-mode setter nor a Fast-mode readback field.

mission_control_launcher_bridge.evidence: The current Mission Control worker adapter polls and records worker events but contains no structured task-creation call that can apply the model/thinking setters or read effective settings. The preflight command therefore defaults appliedSelection to null and fails closed until a real launcher supplies setter evidence.

existing_browser_primitive.evidence: This browser control is bound to fixed ChatGPT supervisor-conversation controls, not Codex Work task creation; it has no Work Fast-mode control and must not be reused as proof of a Work execution profile.

remaining_product_surface_limitation: The current Codex task surface can request model and effort but cannot independently read either back, exposes no Fast-mode setter/readback, and Mission Control has no callable task-creation bridge. Therefore the implementation propagates, validates, persists, and fails closed; it does not claim active end-to-end set-and-verify enforcement.
